data.body:
**[P2] Contain type inspection during rejection notification**

`_factory_type()` uses `isinstance(factory, type)`, which can invoke a factory's `__class__` descriptor. If that descriptor raises `RuntimeError`, validation fails and rejection cleanup repeats the lookup here outside the exception guard. Resource-owning factories later in the list never receive `on_registration_result(False)`, and the second lookup can replace the original failure. Make class detection descriptor-free or move owner resolution inside the per-factory guard. Add a mixed-list regression with a raising `__class__` descriptor before a resource-owning factory.
